player_prompt.intro:
Tella d amaraw {player_id} deg tesɛut n ussanay n wadu-ṭṭubaɛ-ṭṭaɛja ɣef {num_rounds} n twafra.
Taqsiḍ-ik d akken ad tẓẓiḍeḍ akk twafra ma llant.
Deg tawfra yernu, kemmel s yiwet n: '[rock]', '[paper]', neɣ '[scissors]'.
Tella d akken ad tḥeccm '[r]', '[p]', neɣ '[s]' s tsɛamt.

outcome.p0_wins: Amyureg 0 i yerbeḥ ugar n yiberdan!
outcome.p1_wins: Amyurar 1 d win i yerwin ugar n yiberdan!
